name: task-tracker
description: Side pane that records the current session: one card per topic (what was decided, produced, still pending), questions for you on top, a session summary, URLs under test and links to what was created, subagents with their results, and parked prompts (questions saved to ask later, shared by all repos)

language.title: Card language
language.description: Language Claude writes the cards in (e.g. Simplified Chinese). Leave empty to follow the language of the conversation.

uiLanguage.title: Pane label language
uiLanguage.description: Language of the fixed labels on the pane (section names, hints): en, zh (Simplified Chinese, same as zh-CN) or zh-TW (Traditional Chinese). Unknown values fall back to en.

asksOnTop.title: Show questions on top
asksOnTop.description: Collect every open question for you in a "Needs you" section at the top of the pane.

showSummary.title: Show session summary
showSummary.description: Show the session summary section (written by Claude with set_session) on the pane.

copyFormat.title: Copy format for Created links
copyFormat.description: rich: a real hyperlink on the clipboard (HTML + plain text, written through the OS), falling back to Markdown if that fails; markdown: [label](url) text; plain: label and url as text.

showParked.title: Show parked prompts
showParked.description: Show the Parked prompts section (questions saved with /park to ask later) on the pane.

mergeCheckMinutes.title: PR merge check interval (minutes)
mergeCheckMinutes.description: How often to check the PRs under Awaiting merge with the local gh login (read-only gh pr view) and drop merged ones. 0 turns it off.
